data.name: Rehman
data.gender_notes: Rehman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rehman is an Arabic and Urdu name which means the all-knowing, compassionate and merciful one. It is derived from the Arabic word 'rahman' which means 'the most merciful'. The name signifies kindness, compassion, and benevolence. The name Rehman carries the meaning “Benevolent, Merciful, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rehman usually hope their child will grow to embody benevolent, merciful, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rehman is believed to signify the divine attributes of mercy, compassion, and benevolence. It is a name that is often given to boys in Muslim communities as a reminder of the merciful nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Rehman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Benevolent, Merciful, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: الرحمن
in_arabic.meaning: الرحمن هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الرحمة والتعاطف
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرحمن هو واحد من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، مشتق من الرحمة، يعني الرحمة والتعاطف واللطف. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم أكثر من مرة، منها في سورة الفاتحة. يعتبر اسم الرحمن من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبرى في الإسلام، حيث يرتبط بالصفات الإلهية لله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: رحمان
in_urdu.meaning: رحمان اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، رحمت اور مہربانی کا مطلب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رحمان اسلامی تقویم میں اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو رحمت اور مہربانی کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ فاتحہ میں۔ رحمان نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی صفات کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रहमान
in_hindi.meaning: रहमान अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है दया और करुणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहमान इस्लामी परंपरा में अल्लाह के 99 नामों में से एक है, जो दया और करुणा के अर्थ में है। यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है, विशेष रूप से सूरा फातिहा में। रहमान नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की विशेषताओं की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: رحمان
in_pashto.meaning: رحمان د الله د ښو نومونو څخه يو دی، د رحمت او مهربانۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رحمان د اسلامي تقويم په 99 نومونو کې يو دی، د رحمت او مهربانۍ د مفهوم سره. دا نوم د قران کريم په سوره فاتحہ کې ذکر شوی دی. رحمان نوم په اسلامي روایت کې ډیره اهميت لري، ځکه چې دا د الله تعالی صفات بيانوي.

in_english.name: Rehman
in_english.meaning: Rehman means merciful and compassionate, one of Allah's beautiful names
in_english.long_meaning: Rehman is one of the 99 names of Allah in Islamic tradition, derived from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', meaning merciful, compassionate, and kind. It is mentioned in the Quran, particularly in Surah Fatiha. The name Rehman holds significant importance in Islam, as it reflects the divine attributes of Allah. It symbolizes the qualities of mercy, empathy, and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rehman" is popular in the Muslim community, particularly in Pakistan, India, and Bangladesh, as it is deeply rooted in Islamic culture. Naming a child Rehman symbolizes the parents' hopes and aspirations for their child, reflecting the desired qualities of compassion, mercy, and benevolence. The name adds to the child's identity and is often used as a term of endearment, reinforcing the positive attributes associated with it.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic name "Rehman" holds profound spiritual significance as it is derived from the Arabic term for 'the most merciful', which is a fundamental concept in Islamic theology. This name is a constant reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards all his creations. The name inspires individuals to emulate these qualities in their daily lives, fostering a deeper spiritual connection with their Creator. By carrying the name Rehman, an individual is encouraged to strive for merciful actions and practices in accordance with Islamic teachings.
